runExperience.rewardMeaning: Approximate target health-bar progress minus player HP cost; other actors and mechanics can confound it. Confirmed head death or loot confirmation/death give small terminal reward/penalty, not proof that each action was correct/incorrect.

healingPool.occupancyMeaning: Observed position samples on identified pool tiles during the user-defined 10-tick window; missing tick samples are never filled.
